subtasks: Press the two red buttons the required number of times according to the number cards, then press the blue button to confirm.
Release the left red button. Press and fully release the blue button exactly once to confirm the completed left group.
Press the middle red button six times with the left gripper, fully lifting off between presses. Keep the right gripper clear of blue.
Press and fully release the blue confirmation button exactly once with the right gripper to confirm the completed middle group.
Fully open both grippers and return both arms to their respective initial poses. The button sequence is complete.
